_readme: Locked vertical anchors for the card template, in px at the reference card height.
anchor = how the element moves when the card is resized:
top     keeps its distance from the TOP edge
bottom  keeps its distance from the BOTTOM edge
percent keeps its percentage (scales with the card)
These modes were DERIVED by diffing the real v12 (543px) and v14 (600px)
templates, not assumed: the v14 comment describes the rails as top furniture
but the pixels show they are bottom-anchored. tools/template-geometry.js
applies these arithmetically and --check asserts nothing has drifted.

cardLevel.note: card title + botanical name — scales with the card
